subject: Clarifying audit scope & evidence windows for ClearVantage order form
messages:
From: Zoe Wang <zoe.wang@clearvantage.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearvantage.com; legal@clearvantage.com
Date: 2028-05-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form draft — security exhibit questions

Marcus —

Thanks for sending the draft order form and security exhibit. A few items our security team flagged while reviewing the SOC 2 references and inspection language:

- SOC 2: can you provide a short summary statement (1 paragraph) of the scope for your latest Type II so we can confirm coverage for data residency and encryption at rest?
- Pen test access: we need to understand whether pen test windows require VPN/MFA access to a staging environment or whether Redwood will provide attestation and logs only.
- Audit rights: we are comfortable with evidence requests but need a bounded inspection model (time-boxed, sampled, with defined artifact list).

Can you propose specific wording for a ’bounded inspection’ clause? Procurement would like to avoid open-ended on-site inspections.

Zoe
Security Lead, ClearVantage Health

---

On Tue, May 01, 2028 at 10:07 Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Zoe Wang <zoe.wang@clearvantage.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>; Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>; procurement@clearvantage.com; legal@clearvantage.com
Date: 2028-05-01T10:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form draft — security exhibit questions

Hi Zoe —

Appreciate the quick review. Attaching a redline (clearvantage_security_exhibit_v2_redlines.pdf) and a short suggested clause (proposed-bounded-inspection-language.txt) that maps to the language we typically accept for enterprise customers. Quick answers up front:

- SOC 2: we’ve attached a 1-page summary of the Type II scope (SOC2-TypeII-2027-summary.pdf) — covers infrastructure, change management, logical access controls; does not include customer environments.
- Pen test: our standard is to provide a staging environment for credentialed pen tests. We can support scoped tests with ephemeral credentials and a two-week window; alternatively we can provide vendor attestation and the full pen-test report redacted for customer-sensitive details.
- Audit rights: the proposed clause limits inspection to quarterly 4-hour remote sessions, or up to one onsite visit per year with 30 days’ notice, and a predefined artifact list (logs, configuration snapshots, SOC 2 report).

If that sounds reasonable I can loop in Legal to propose the exact MSA/Order Form redline. If procurement prefers attestation-only we can offer that as well for a one-time fee.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: clearvantage_security_exhibit_v2_redlines.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)
Attachment: proposed-bounded-inspection-language.txt (TXT, 2 KB)

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Zoe Wang <zoe.wang@clearvantage.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>; Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form draft — security exhibit questions

Zoe / Marcus —

Thanks — I reviewed Marcus’ suggested language and made one legal-oriented tweak to the evidence list to avoid overly broad discovery requests. Key changes:

- Evidence list: replaced ‘all operational logs’ with ‘relevant system logs and consolidated audit summaries as specified in Appendix A’ to prevent ad hoc raw log dump requests.
- Onsite visits: clarified that any onsite inspection must be mutually agreed and limited to Redwood data centers where Redwood controls the environment; customer-managed deployments (Private) remain out of scope unless separately contracted.
- Pen test: inserted a clause allowing Redwood to redact customer-identifying details in third-party reports prior to sharing.

I’ll produce inline redlines for the MSA and Order Form (legal-ready). Marcus — can you confirm whether ClearVantage will accept remote-only inspection or needs the one onsite-per-year option?

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-2027-summary.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

---

From: Zoe Wang <zoe.wang@clearvantage.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>; Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearvantage.com; legal@clearvantage.com
Date: 2028-05-03T11:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form draft — security exhibit questions

Laura / Marcus —

Thank you — procurement prefers remote-only inspections for now. Legal is okay with the redaction approach for pen-test reports. Two asks before we proceed to redline the Order Form:

1) Please add a definitive artifact list in Appendix A (sample fields: system audit summary, deployment config snapshot, SOC 2 summary, pen test executive summary).
2) For pen tests, confirm windowing: we need a minimum notice period of 14 days to schedule a remote test and a maximum 3-day result turnaround for confirmations that critical issues have been triaged.

If you can add those items we’ll move to a formal redline on our side.

Zoe

---

On Fri, May 03, 2028 at 13:02 Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Zoe Wang <zoe.wang@clearvantage.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>; Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T13:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form draft — security exhibit questions

Zoe —

We can do remote-only with the following commitments:

- Appendix A: adding an artifact checklist (high-level only) — will attach updated Appendix A by EOD.
- Pen test window: Redwood will provide 14 days notice minimum for scheduling; Redwood commits to confirming remediation prioritization within 3 business days for any findings classified as Critical.
- Staging access: ephemeral credentials on a scoped staging environment; no customer production access will be provided.

Laura will push legal-ready redlines with the clarified artifact list and the exact Order Form language. Next steps: I’ll get the Appendix A by close of day; Laura please prepare MSA/Order Form inline redlines for Monday.

Marcus

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Zoe Wang <zoe.wang@clearvantage.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>; Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-04T17:45:00Z
Subject: Updated Appendix A and next steps

Hi all —

Attached: a tight Appendix A (artifact-checklist-AppendixA.pdf) that maps each request to an evidence owner and access path. Highlights:

- Audit artifacts (remote): SOC 2 summary, system audit summary (daily aggregated), configuration snapshot (as of request date).
- Pen test: executive summary and technical appendix (redacted). Full reports will only be shared with an NDA + written consent.
- Timing: remote evidence sessions will be scheduled in 2-hour blocks; we propose using two blocks per quarter for routine requests.

Action items
- Marcus: share the updated Appendix A link in the Order Form and confirm procurement will accept the remote-only model (you flagged potential procurement pushback).
- Laura: finalize MSA & Order Form inline redlines with the tightened artifact language and the pen-test redaction clause.
- Zoe: confirm if the 2-hour per-quarter cadence works or if ClearVantage needs additional slots during onboarding.

Thanks — I’ll be on standby to join legal calls next week if needed.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Security — Redwood Inference

Attachment: artifact-checklist-AppendixA.pdf (PDF, 36 KB)
